senses.gloss:
लटह, लडह a. Beautiful, handsome (a Prākṛta word);
 see लटभ.

लड् I. €1 P. (लडति) To play, sport, dally.
━II. €1 P., €10 P. (लडति, लडयति)
—1 To throw, toss.
—2 To blame.
—3 To loll the tongue.
—4 To harass, annoy.
━III. €10 U. (लाडयति-ते) —1 To fondle, caress.
—2 To annoy.

लाड् €10 U. (लाडयति-ते)
—1 To fondle, caress.
—2 To blame, censure.
—3 To throw, toss; cf. लड्.

लड्डुः, लड्डुकः A kind of sweetmeat (a round ball of sugar,
 wheat or rice-flour, ghee, and spices).
